forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not treat cells as independent biological replicates, guess sample or subject identity, overwrite source counts, or silently drop zero-count composition rows.
Do not fit a rank-deficient design, a subject-free longitudinal model, an unregistered coefficient, or a random effect without repeated levels.
Do not present fixed-only propeller output as repeated-measure inference, interpret composition as absolute abundance, hide reference discordance, or select references by desired effect direction.
Do not report generated code, successful exit status, or unreloaded files as validated evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose the simplest scientifically justified estimable fixed and random structures; use splines only when time coverage supports them and declare a separate variance formula.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require full-rank fixed designs, adequate repeated random levels, matched coefficient names, and an explicit joint test for multi-basis hypotheses.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use repeated-measure dream as primary, propeller as fixed-only sensitivity, and multiple biologically defensible ALR references.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Do not admit reference-discordant effects or interpret a closure-induced shift as absolute abundance.

postflight_checks: Reconcile all input cells and counts to pseudobulks and complete sample-by-cell-type composition rows.
Inspect every cell-type model, retained genes, fixed-design rank, random levels, dream errors and warnings, matched coefficients, individual and joint tests, variance fractions, and output reloads.
Inspect composition closure, zeros, primary repeated-measure effects, fixed-only propeller sensitivity, every ALR reference, directional support, discordance, FDR, and output reloads.
preflight_checks: Inspect actual H5AD counts, cells, features, sample and subject cross-tabs, time points, conditions, cell types, covariates, missingness, sample balance, cell counts, library sizes, source digest, and output paths.
Detect exact Python, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, R, variancePartition, speckle, edgeR, limma, lme4, lmerTest, BiocParallel, jsonlite, and digest versions in existing compatible runtimes.

Validate formulas, coefficient regexes, fixed-design rank, repeated random levels, pseudobulk thresholds, composition references, pseudocount, multiplicity, and degrees-of-freedom method before fitting.

template_sections.purpose: Establish experimental units, repeated observations, raw-count semantics, estimability, and frozen hypotheses.
required_logic: Inspect immutable counts, sample, subject, time, condition, cell type, covariates, missingness, balance, repeated-subject coverage, source digest, and cell accounting.
Validate each sample has one subject and design record and predeclare hypothesis and variance formulas separately.
Freeze coefficient patterns, filtering, degrees-of-freedom, composition references, multiplicity, and admission thresholds before viewing desired results.

template_sections.purpose: Create count-conserving pseudobulks and complete composition inputs.
required_logic: Aggregate immutable integer-like counts by biological sample and reviewed cell type without densifying source counts.
Retain eligible and reason-coded excluded pseudobulks and include zero-count sample-cell-type composition rows.
Reconcile every cell, total raw count, sample total, composition grid row, and proportion sum before modeling.

template_sections.purpose: Fit estimable linear or nonlinear repeated-subject expression hypotheses.
required_logic: Within each cell type filter genes from raw pseudobulk counts, apply TMM and voomWithDreamWeights, and fit dream with an explicit subject random effect.
Verify fixed-design rank and repeated random levels and retain dream errors, warnings, degrees of freedom, every matched coefficient, and a joint test for multiple spline basis terms.
Fit variance components with the separately declared variance formula and never reuse a non-estimable fixed hypothesis as a variance formula.

template_sections.purpose: Test repeated-measure composition while respecting closure and reference dependence.
required_logic: Fit the repeated-subject dream logit-proportion model as primary inference and retain zero-count cell types with an explicit pseudocount.
Run propeller.anova only as fixed-effect sensitivity because it does not model repeated subjects in this contract.
Fit additive-log-ratio dream models across multiple predeclared reference cell types and admit only directionally stable effects with sufficient reference support.

template_sections.purpose: Independently verify statistical outputs and admit only design-supported claims.
required_logic: Reload all pseudobulk, metadata, composition, expression, variance, ALR, and diagnostic files and verify row, coefficient, digest, version, and range invariants.
Review effect direction, joint tests, FDR, variance fractions, model diagnostics, closure, fixed-only sensitivity, and ALR reference concordance.
Route unsupported, confounded, singular, discordant, or underpowered results to redesign or sensitivity analysis rather than narrative promotion.

assumptions: Biological samples, not cells, are experimental units; subjects identify repeated observations; the supplied cell types are independently reviewed; expression uses immutable raw counts; and composition is interpreted under closure with multiple reference choices.

description: Direct Codex to validate count-backed annotated single-cell data, aggregate immutable counts by biological sample and cell type, fit linear or spline longitudinal dream models with subject random effects, quantify variance components, and test cell-type composition with repeated-measure, propeller, and multi-reference additive-log-ratio evidence without treating cells as replicates.
intents: single-cell nonlinear time course and variance partition
单细胞纵向混合模型 细胞组成差异分析
limitations: Validated execution covers count-backed H5AD input, 24 samples from eight subjects across three time points, linear and natural-spline condition-by-time dream hypotheses, separately declared variance decomposition, and three-cell-type composition with repeated-measure logit models, fixed-only propeller sensitivity, and three additive-log-ratio references. The public GSE96583 case validates an eight-donor paired condition design and must not be presented as a multi-timepoint trajectory; nonlinear time and spline behavior retain planted-signal fixture evidence. It does not make cell-level models valid, repair confounding, infer cell identities, establish causality, or guarantee power for rare cell types. speckle 1.2.0 propeller.ttest was not used because its one-coefficient result drops dimensions in the observed runtime; propeller.anova is retained only as fixed-effect sensitivity. Execution requires a compatible project-approved scientific runtime.
preconditions: The H5AD contains unique cells and features, nonnegative integer-like raw counts, internally consistent sample-level metadata, repeated subjects, adequate samples and cells per pseudobulk, at least three cell types for composition, a full-rank estimable design, frozen formulas and coefficients, and new output paths.

concept_sources: Project-owned longitudinal and composition workflow with biological-sample aggregation, repeated-subject mixed models, nonlinear joint tests, and closure-aware sensitivity analysis.

quality_gates.description: Block when biological sample, subject, repeated time, condition, covariate, cell-type, raw-count, or contrast semantics cannot be established from the actual object and study design.
Every input cell must map exactly once into a sample-cell-type pseudobulk and complete sample-by-cell-type composition grid, with raw counts conserved and exclusions reason-coded.
Every fitted cell type requires adequate biological samples and repeated subjects, a full-rank fixed design, valid random-effect levels, predeclared coefficients, and captured dream diagnostics.
Linear or spline time hypotheses must use an explicit subject random effect and report every matched coefficient plus a joint test when the hypothesis spans multiple basis terms.
Variance components require a separately declared estimable variance formula and must reload as finite fractions within their expected range.

Composition inference must retain zero counts, validate the complete grid and closure, use a repeated-measure primary model, label fixed-only propeller output as sensitivity evidence, and test multiple additive-log-ratio references.
Reload expression, variance, composition, additive-log-ratio, metadata, and diagnostic outputs and reconcile rows, coefficients, directions, digests, versions, and quality status before admission.

questions: Which cell-type-specific expression programs and cell-type proportions change across condition and time after accounting for repeated subjects, covariates, count depth, compositional closure, and reference sensitivity?
